S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 810 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Shariq Khurshid, learned counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Dy. Advocate General with Ms. Meenakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By the instant C482 application, the applicant is challenging the proceedings of Criminal Complaint Case No. 2377 of 2023, Smt. Sunita Devi vs. Durgesh Kumar & others, pending in the court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar, wherein the applicants have been summoned under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC.
4.

entities.text: Sunita Devi vs. Durgesh Kumar & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that son of applicant no. 1 and 2 married with respondent no. 2 on 08.02.2010 and out of this wed-lock two female child were born and living with respondent no. 2.
The allegations are with regard to the harassment and demand of dowry.

5. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 returnable within a week.
6.
Learned counsel for the applicants shall take steps to serve respondent no. 2 through the counsel representing her before the Trial Court within three days.

7. Taking into consideration that the allegations appears to be matrimonial in nature and marriage took place on 08.02.2010 and two daughters were born out of this wed-lock and are living with respondent no. 2, therefore, efforts should be made for amicable settlement.

8. Let applicant nos. 1 and 2 with their son Durgesh Kumar and respondent no. 2 shall remain present before this Court on the date fixed.
9. Put up this matter on 18.06.2024.
